Composition & Indication

Pediatric Loratadine Syrup 5mg/5mL — 60 mL Bottle contains Loratadine 5 mg per 5 mL as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 60 mL Bottle at the official 5mg/5mL strength. The standard indication is the management of pediatric seasonal allergies, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Pediatric Loratadine Syrup 5mg/5mL is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
